items.title: Intro | Building a Streamhouse
items.author: Confluent Developer
items.summary:
https://developer.confluent.io/learn/streamhouse/ | More and more software acts on the state of the business: querying it continuously, acting immediately, with no human in the loop to notice that an answer is six hours old. When that happens, the failure isn't a stale dashboard. It's a confident, wrong action.

The Streamhouse is a new category of software architecture built for this. It keeps the business's current state up to date as events arrive, governs it once, and serves the same data to apps, agents, and the lakehouse.

This video traces how we got here, from the data warehouse to the lakehouse, introduces the five layers of a Streamhouse, and shows one running: a delivery fleet whose trucks, parcels, weather, and traffic are kept as one current state.

items.title: Demo: Lightning Tables on Confluent Cloud
items.author: Confluent, an IBM Company
items.summary:
See how Lightning Tables in Confluent Cloud serves the current state of of the business as a fully managed read-only layer—so AI agents and applications can query fresh context at low latency and high concurrency, without ETL, separate databases, or caches. The demo shows how to enable Lightning Tables on Kafka topics for instant querying.

items.title: Tableflow Demo: Kafka to BigQuery Without ETL Pipelines
items.author: Confluent, an IBM Company
items.summary:
See how Confluent Tableflow makes Apache Kafka® data available in Google BigQuery as open Apache Iceberg™ tables with 5-minute freshness, without ETL pipelines. Follow a payments processor as it brings streaming data into BigQuery, explores native Debezium CDC support (Early Access), and uses Gemini-powered Conversational Analytics to identify operational risks in plain English, helping teams get answers and act sooner.

This is Streamhouse for analytics in action: fresh, continuously updated business data that helps teams spot operational risks and act sooner, without another pipeline to manage.

items.title: Hybrid Demo: USM, Hybrid Connectors, and Confluent Gateway
items.author: Confluent, an IBM Company
items.summary:
See how USM, hybrid connectors, and Confluent Gateway help govern Apache Kafka® across on-premises and cloud environments while keeping sensitive data within your perimeter. Follow a payments processor as it traces data lineage, manages on-premises connectors from the cloud, and enforces encryption and schema validation for legacy clients without code changes, simplifying operations and demonstrating compliance. Hybrid connector management and Gateway advanced governance capabilities shown are in Early Access.

items.title: Hybrid Demo: Confluent Private Cloud (CPC) Multi-tenancy and Gateway Disaster Recovery-Failover
items.author: Confluent, an IBM Company
items.summary:
See how RiverPay, a fictitious payments processor, uses Confluent Private Cloud (CPC) multi-tenancy to run isolated payment, settlement, and FX workloads on one shared Kafka cluster. When a broker drops during a traffic surge, Confluent Gateway fails over to a standby without client reconfiguration, helping keep payments flowing.
